bugs.error_message: fatal: pathspec 'package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml ...' did not match any files
bugs.root_cause: Agent Bash runs zsh, which does not word-split unquoted $VAR, so a space-separated file list became one pathspec
bugs.fix: Use a zsh array FILES=(...) and "${FILES[@]}"

bugs.error_message: error TS18003: No inputs were found in config file tsconfig.json (include ["*.ts","*.js"])

bugs.fix: Add allowJs + checkJs to root tsconfig compilerOptions

bugs.error_message: pnpm add --save-exact @types/node@26 wrote "^26.6.3"

bugs.fix: Hand-edit to exact version, then pnpm install to update lockfile specifier

bugs.error_message: Biome DEPRECATED: The use of the recommended field has been deprecated ... Use preset instead
bugs.root_cause: Biome 2.5 replaced linter.rules.recommended:boolean with rules.preset

bugs.error_message: zsh: no such file or directory: node /Users/samuel/.claude/gsd-core/bin/gsd-tools.cjs

bugs.error_message: CR-01: compose-smoke cannot pass on Linux CI (config.yaml 0600 under umask 077; ./backups not writable by uid 1000)
bugs.root_cause: umask 077 applied to the config.yaml copy; backups/ owned by runner uid 1001; Docker Desktop on macOS hides host uids
bugs.fix: (umask 022 && cp ...) for config.yaml; on Linux with uid != 1000 chown 1000 backups (as_root/sudo -n) or fail early; README Linux step; compose-smoke.test.ts stubs docker/uname/id/sudo

bugs.error_message: WR-01: compose-smoke COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME did not isolate the db volume; --down could delete sift-pgdata
bugs.root_cause: compose.yaml pinned volume name sift-pgdata for every project
bugs.fix: volume name ${SIFT_PGDATA_VOLUME:-sift-pgdata}; smoke exports <project>-pgdata-smoke, refuses sift-pgdata and (outside CI) the default project

bugs.error_message: WR-02: worker role guard accepted sift_owner (CREATEROLE, owns schema)
bugs.root_cause: guard checked only rolsuper/rolbypassrls
bugs.fix: guard also rejects CREATEROLE, CREATEDB, owning objects, and membership in any role (pg_has_role MEMBER)

bugs.error_message: WR-06: catalog gate missed column-level SELECT/INSERT grants
bugs.root_cause: has_table_privilege is false for column-level grants
bugs.fix: use has_any_column_privilege for app_select/app_insert/backup_insert

bugs.error_message: WR-07: catalog gate did not check sift_app memberships beyond sift_owner
bugs.root_cause: only pg_has_role(sift_app, sift_owner) was checked; NOINHERIT hides membership privileges
bugs.fix: membershipProblems(client, role) lists every role sift_app is a member of; tested on a throwaway stand-in role (never grant to the shared sift_app in tests)

bugs.error_message: WR-03: shutdown hung when a batch outlived SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS (pool.end waits for checked-out clients)
bugs.root_cause: pg-pool end() resolves only after every client is released
bugs.fix: AppDb.close({ timeoutMs }) ends remaining clients after the timeout (pg Client.end destroys the socket when a query is active); worker uses CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS 3 s

bugs.error_message: WR-04: migrate counted pending while drizzle compares timestamps; skipped migration reported as none pending
bugs.root_cause: drizzle applies only migrations with folderMillis > last created_at
bugs.fix: journal when must strictly increase; pending computed with drizzle's rule; MigrationOrderError before any change; post-apply count check

bugs.error_message: WR-05: rename hint paired removed (sorted) and added (config order) slugs by position
bugs.root_cause: positional pairing of two differently ordered lists
bugs.fix: findRenameSuspects(changes, rows) returns pairs: 1-1 as is, otherwise unique IMAP identity matches only

bugs.error_message: WR-08: poll intervals not multiple of 15 s tick were rounded up
bugs.root_cause: runs only started on fixed 15 s ticks
bugs.fix: next tick at min(tickMs, earliest idle nextRunAt); finished runs call wakeAt; failed registry read falls back to tickMs

bugs.error_message: CR-02: local compose-smoke runs dumped into ./backups and pruned the owner pre-migration dumps
bugs.root_cause: setup always bind-mounted ./backups; smoke volume is fresh so every run migrates, dumps and prunes
bugs.fix: compose.yaml mounts ${SIFT_BACKUP_HOST_DIR:-./backups}; smoke exports .smoke/<project>/backups and refuses a dir resolving to ./backups

bugs.error_message: WR-09: compose-smoke project guard was env-var based (CI=true or COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=owner project recreated owner containers)
bugs.root_cause: guard only compared env vars, not Docker state
bugs.fix: before the EXIT trap: docker ps for the project; refuse unless a container mounts the smoke volume

bugs.error_message: IN-08: smoke stack used owner config.yaml/.env/.env.mailboxes and retagged sift:local
bugs.root_cause: compose paths and image hard-coded
bugs.fix: SIFT_IMAGE/SIFT_CONFIG_HOST_DIR/SIFT_MAILBOXES_ENV_FILE interpolation; smoke files in .smoke/<project>, --env-file, sift-smoke:local

bugs.error_message: WR-04: migrate counted rows; a foreign applied row hid a skipped journal migration
bugs.root_cause: row count vs journal length, not identity
bugs.fix: refuse any journal entry neither pending nor recorded by hash (also catches edited applied files)

bugs.error_message: IN-01: D-64 duplicate check did not trim host/username/folder; registry-plan identity differed
bugs.root_cause: two identity helpers, one untrimmed
bugs.fix: shared imapIdentityKey in @sift/core/config (trim, lowercase host/user, INBOX fold)

bugs.error_message: IN-02: ISO-04 lint guard missed relative imports of packages/*/src
bugs.root_cause: noRestrictedImports only listed pg/drizzle-orm
bugs.fix: pattern group **/packages/*/src/** and @sift/*/src/**; lint-guard test

bugs.error_message: IN-03: sift_app password sent as plaintext in CREATE/ALTER ROLE
bugs.root_cause: role DDL takes no bind params; escapeLiteral(password)
bugs.fix: client-built SCRAM-SHA-256 verifier (scram.ts); bootstrap.sql still plaintext, documented log_statement

bugs.error_message: IN-04: unexpected worker errors bypassed pino and redaction
bugs.root_cause: only DatabaseStartupError caught; rest went to cli stderr
bugs.fix: catch in worker.run, unwrap drizzle Failed query to pg cause, log SQLSTATE + redacted message, return 1

bugs.error_message: IN-06: mailbox disabled while worker down kept stale mailbox_status.state
bugs.root_cause: stopMailbox only for scheduled mailboxes
bugs.fix: recordedDisabled set: record each disable once per process, incl. first sight

bugs.error_message: IN-13: batch longer than poll interval reran back-to-back
bugs.root_cause: nextRunAt = start + interval already past
bugs.fix: nextRunAt = start + ceil(elapsed/interval)*interval (D-50 skip)

bugs.error_message: IN-09/IN-10: rename hint paired 1:1 slugs regardless of IMAP identity and printed empty unpaired lists
bugs.root_cause: no identity check in 1:1 case; lines printed unconditionally
bugs.fix: identityDiffers flag + warning; print each unpaired list only when non-empty

bugs.error_message: IN-11: worker role guard and catalog gate ignored REPLICATION
bugs.root_cause: rolreplication not selected
bugs.fix: REPLICATION reason in assertUnprivilegedRole; attributeProblems in catalog

bugs.error_message: IN-12: forced close missed pool clients still in handshake; socket kept process alive
bugs.root_cause: clients tracked from pg-pool connect event (post-handshake); Client.end only half-closes a connecting client
bugs.fix: TrackedClient registers on construction; forced close destroys connection.stream after end()

bugs.error_message: Wrong reference: VERIFICATION_PENDING should be exit
bugs.root_cause: Used "VERIFICATION_PENDING" instead of "exit"
bugs.fix: Changed VERIFICATION_PENDING → exit

bugs.error_message: IN-05: a worker whose heartbeat stalls (registry read failing or hung) stays unhealthy forever; Docker restarts only on exit
bugs.root_cause: Healthcheck only marks the container unhealthy; restart: unless-stopped acts only on exit and nothing in the supervisor exited after missed heartbeats
bugs.fix: Supervisor counts consecutive missed heartbeats (failed or overdue ticks) and resolves `stalled` at 3; worker logs the reason, drains, exits 75; compose worker restart: on-failure
